name: Total Care Package (IFEC predictive maintenance)
summary: Tom Eskola, vice president of Panasonic Technical Services, told AviTrader on October 22 that PTS already uses remote diagnostics, real-time monitoring, data-driven troubleshooting and proactive maintenance planning across in-flight entertainment and connectivity (IFEC) systems. He said its Total Care Package can include advanced diagnostics and predictive maintenance strategies, and that AI will help anticipate some non-routine findings before a maintenance event, as an improving probability rather than a certainty.

whyItMatters: A dead seat screen or a down Wi-Fi system turns into refunds, complaints and lost charter repeat business. Catching cabin system faults before the aircraft arrives at the hangar lets you have the parts and people ready, which shortens the visit.
